question: Which divine figure appears at the junction of Kali and Dvāpara ages?
premises: Kṛṣṇa is identified as the Blessed Lord
He appears at the junction of Kali and Dvāpara
inference: Kṛṣṇa, the Blessed Lord himself, appears at the junction of Kali and Dvāpara
plain_english: He is indeed Kṛṣṇa, the Blessed Lord, who appears at the junction of the Kali and Dvāpara ages.
